endpoint: Extract an explicit extra strict class from a possibly incomplete equation-only relation computation, without requiring a completed BNF.
inputs: Frozen reference equation/generic projection, the eligible early principal-relation pool, and exact accepted elements from the seeded relation-only memory-corrected run. No exceptional point input.
method: Deduplicate primitive elements modulo rational scaling and sign; norm projection changes such scaling by a fourth power. Factor every additional principal ideal exactly. Eliminate outside-S valuation parity with complete prime blocks. Combine the surviving norm-square products with all sixteen generic classes; impose local squares at every finite S place and positivity at every real embedding. Evaluate fixed good-prime residue characters to certify independence, never to assert dependence or completeness.
failure_semantics: A character rank increase certifies independence. Failure to detect an increase is not a class-group upper bound. Positive classes require subsequent independent ideal/local replay. No exceptional class, specialization mechanism, rationality or Sha status is claimed without its certificate.
